reason: Both plans satisfy all hard requirements, but Response B is the more complete and usable plan: it adds an explicit, separately-gated Phase 4 for legacy decommissioning (satisfying the 'not in the same phase as final migration' constraint more directly than A's vague 'out of scope, later initiative'), and its entry criteria are more concretely measurable (specific invoice-accuracy percentages, incident severities, dual-write retention periods) across every phase.
